newsitem.title: USA: American Federal Bank ups qtly dividend.
newsitem.headline: American Federal Bank ups qtly dividend.

text.p: American Federal Bank FSB reported a 20 percent increase in its regular quarterly dividend on Thursday to $0.12 per share from $0.10 previously.
The dividend is payable on February 10, record January 24.

The company said the increase reflects growth in earnings announced on January 15, and marks the fourth straight year dividends have increased at least 20 percent. The bank began paying dividends in 1993.
American Federal has $1.3 billion in assets and 40 branch offices covering 12 counties in northwestern South Carolina.
